notes: Follow-up to the serialization-length control, prompted by the observation that its two single-class reference contrasts confound serialization form with prompt length.
Four serializations of the same 24 bin masses; the two anchors are re-acquired so every comparison is within one acquisition.

The pivot condition sits 84 characters from the positional anchor and 374 from the fully labelled one, so the length gaps favour the length account a priori and the sign of the contrast separates the two accounts.
